prices.basis: USD per 1,000,000 tokens, standard model global public marginal gross. Not invoice cash or net spend.
prices.context: Same published rates for <=200K and >200K input. Prompt includes cached tokens; subtract cache reads once. Candidate output and thought counts are disjoint.

sources.verification: Rendered by root browser on local 2026-10-08: Standard Model, discounts OFF, Global Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite row and both context bands. Numeric rates directly verified.
sources.supports: Standard global rates; only successful 200 requests charged; non-global routing has a 10% uplift. Advertised 3.8 Flash promotion has net-credit conditions and is excluded.
Exact model ID, global endpoint availability, text output and PAYG/provisioned support; model name alone does not prove PAYG.
trafficType ON_DEMAND identifies standard pay-as-you-go; PROVISIONED_THROUGHPUT/ON_DEMAND_PRIORITY/ON_DEMAND_FLEX excluded. Explicit prompt/cache/candidate/thought/total counts and modality details.
Project/location/publisher/model resource route and cumulative response usage.

admission: Snapshot the eligible native client project/global endpoint before invoking the provider method, then require call-local transport evidence: exact dispatched request and final response URL, successful HTTP status, and no redirects. Configuration alone is not route proof; unavailable evidence stays unpriced.

TypeScript additionally requires fresh call-local native Undici request, wire-send, successful response and body-completion evidence. A replaced global fetch returning cached, fabricated or recovered responses without that evidence cannot establish the admitted lane; runtimes without the native diagnostics remain unpriced. Custom TypeScript httpOptions.fetch, configured TypeScript retryOptions, and unsupported Python HTTP clients/transports remain excluded. Python transport evidence currently covers native HTTPX only; optional aiohttp and mTLS Google-auth session paths remain unpriced. Transport observation preserves native options, results, errors and streaming behavior; it does not rewrite routing/retries or consume response bodies.

Transport proofs and captured public-method wrappers belong to one instrumentation installation. Both observation and final pricing admission require the same still-active installation. Streams retained across uninstall/reinstall can finish with usage-only observations in their original tracker, never with a stale priced lane or new-tracker ownership. Retained Python methods invoked after reinstall keep their established current-tracker usage ownership but cannot acquire a new installation's pricing proof.
Successful native completion only, response trafficType exactly ON_DEMAND; response exact modelVersion and nonblank responseId required.

All five prompt/cache/candidate/thought/total counters must be explicitly present nonnegative safe integers; unknown optional counters are NOT synthesized as zero for admission. This intentionally leaves incomplete native responses unpriced.
total == prompt + candidates + thoughts, cache <= prompt, no tool-use tokens. Positive prompt/cache/candidate counters require matching TEXT-only modality totals.

Request contents and optional system instruction are bounded concrete text shapes; no one-shot iterable consumption. Tool/media/explicit-cache/unknown configs, HTTP/body/resource-scope/auth-header overrides and cross-project model paths unpriced.

Finish reason STOP/MAX_TOKENS, exactly one text candidate; grounding and URL tools excluded. Streams use last cumulative usage snapshot only, and incomplete/error/cancelled streams cannot receive succeeded pricing.
Usage dimensions include cloud_project and vertex_pricing_lane=global_standard_paygo_text; provider.region=global is an independent server selector.
excluded: Regional endpoints/uplifts, Express mode/API-key-only routes without verified project, gateways/Mantle/other providers, other models or aliases
Provisioned throughput, priority, flex, batch, context-cache creation/storage, search/tools/grounding, media and unknown modalities
Promotional credits, negotiated rates, reservations/commitments, invoice cash/net spend, taxes or account-level fees
Gemini 3.8 Flash promotion: current .75/.075/3.75 table footnote is 50% credits back on NET spend, not safe unconditional public gross; Jan1 2027 standard tariff is not effective now

verification.python_native: google-genai 1.73.1, real Models/AsyncModels and typed native response parser with native HTTPX transport I/O mocked and anonymous test credentials; unsupported custom transports are negative cases
verification.typescript_native: @google/genai 2.27.0, real GoogleGenAI/Models with anonymous test auth and native Node fetch connected to a loopback-only HTTP fixture through a pinned test-only Undici dispatcher. Positive cases exercise real native diagnostics; fabricated/cached global fetch and custom client fetch are negative cases. No provider network requests are made.
verification.money: Identical SDK/server JSON vectors link raw provider-shaped response through v3 identity, disjoint metric quantities and dimensions to exact server scaled-BigInt USD totals and replay checks.
verification.boundary: Observed native transport routing/status and normalized response usage are independent admission requirements. Python Pydantic may coerce raw JSON scalar types; raw-helper boolean rejection is tested without falsely claiming pre-parser raw-wire scalar validation. Arbitrary hostile code that forges native transport metadata is outside this in-process observer's trust boundary.
